scenario: [LSER.13.14]: `capacity: N` on a series block takes a positive integer, and the compiler must refuse one below 1 with `DS_VALIDATE_CAPACITY_NOT_POSITIVE` -- the same code the slot form uses ([LSTR.11.1]). The grammar types the value as `INT_LIT` ([LGRA.7.1]), so `0` parses and reaches validation. PATH PINNED: `dsc.series.lser_13_14_capacity`'s `N < 1` arm, reached through `block_kwarg_value("capacity", ...)` in `dsc.parse`.
